Owen Wilson stars in the comedy "Stick," which has many similarities to "Ted Lasso," and Apple has just announced the show will return for Season 2 — "Ted Lasso" actress and "Pluribus" star Rhea Seehorn has also joined the cast.

"Stick" Season 2 will premiere on November 4, with Rhea Seehorn joining the cast

After the Season 3 finale of "Ted Lasso" aired, no one knew if the show would return. Lasso fans were fortunate enough to wait for its comeback, and Season 4 is currently airing.

However, during this show's hiatus, Apple TV launched a new series with strong Lasso DNA.

Owen Wilson's "Stick" premiered last summer and was immediately compared to "Ted Lasso," being hailed as another heartwarming sports comedy. Now, shortly after "Lasso" Season 4 wraps up, "Stick" is set to return.

"Stick" Season 2 will premiere its first two episodes on November 4 (Wednesday), then release one new episode weekly until wrapping up on December 30.

Here's the show's synopsis provided by Apple (spoiler-free):

According to Apple's press release, the new season will see Santi pursuing the next step in his professional golf journey, while Pryce also comes back to the sport.

The strong cast of "Stick" will return for Season 2, including, in addition to Wilson, Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant.

"Pluribus" actress Rhea Seehorn will join the cast, playing Pryce's new golf coach. Other new additions to the cast include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Linn, Sasha Alexander, and Missi Pyle.

You can watch Season 1 of "Stick" on Apple TV now.

Are you a fan of "Stick"? Are you planning to watch Season 2? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can get a discount through the Apple One bundle.
